headline: Trump supports work of CIICIG in Guatemala
content: The ambassador of the USA to the United Nations, Nikki Haley expressed yesterday full support of their country and international community towards Ivan Velázquez, head of the International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala (CIICIG), whom Guatemalan President Jimmy Morales declared non-grata last Sunday.The attempt made by the President of Guatemala to remove Iván Velásquez from Guatemala is deeply concerning, emphasized Haley in a statement following the same tone as Antonio Gutérrez, Secretary General of the UN who considered himself impacted by the news.The decision taken by Morales came after CIICIG along with Public Ministry announced Friday that the president lost immunity allowing investigations regarding alleged illegal funding during his electoral campaign back in 2015 when he won elections.The fact generated an institutional crisis in Central America where eight senior officials left government, two being dismissed.Also there were protests in the street while Constitutional Court, highest judicial instance in the country granted temporary protection to commissioner of the UN ensuring him remaining legally in the country.Legal system would resolve soon whether maintaining said protection allows commission staying in the nation.
